scope: Two actual 60-wall-second runs with three full-J IK updates on one frozen law/K, dt0.5 per update, total1.5s. Snapshot/MarkerArray/stiffness/metadata/scene/TF/goal-source actual wire and independently reconstructed numerical laws are audited separately from physical stability.

physical_pose_accuracy.covariance_width_definition: 3*sqrt(trace(P)), a diagnostic Euclidean width; anisotropic Gaussian proxy coverage uses support-aware Mahalanobis chi-square95

trajectory_supplement.supplementary_scope: Read-only trajectory geometry, timing and descriptive physical differences; full law/J/K/trajectory validity is covered by separate independent audits.
trajectory_supplement.interval_dt_source: physical_trajectory original elapsed time; epoch timestamp subtraction is separately bounded by two epoch ULPs
trajectory_supplement.reversal_definition: Adjacent commanded velocities with opposite signs and both magnitudes greater than 1e-6 rad/s; zero-crossings with an intervening stopped tick are not counted.
notes: Tick displacement depends on measured tick dt; it is not a discontinuity test.
Absolute physical pose is only evaluated after the run and was not provided to either worker.
Hardware acceleration limits can leave nonzero physical command velocity while an expired plan requests zero.
The three future reference knots are virtual command predictions, not observed or actually executed future poses.

limitations: The user rejected this implementation because oscillation was severe. Unit tests, same-law consistency and transient 6mm reaching do not establish acceptable smoothness; the horizon was subsequently withdrawn.

Both cases satisfy the existential simulator reach predicate at least once and have no forbidden collision, but both finish outside the 6mm tolerance. These facts do not override the failed motion-quality requirement.
Recorded reference switching, latency, saturation and velocity reversals are descriptive diagnostics, not a proven unique cause of the oscillation.

All sensor-native image modes are retained before the explicitly allowed board-central projection; ordered ADF, conditional independence and nonclosed forward/inverse moment approximations remain assumptions.
Absolute body accuracy and anisotropic covariance coverage are measured independently; no true pose/K calibration or exact full-history posterior is claimed.
Only selected latest captures are fused. Every acquired frame and selection is archived; camera capture cadence and pose-estimate update cadence are distinct.

historical_audit_state_correction.scope: The original independent auditor reset its own remembered representative backtrack scale on a density-identity update. Production correctly retained0.0625 and used0.125 at the next changed-density epoch. The auditor alone was corrected, with no tolerance/runtime/density/score change; the original two discrepancies are preserved separately. All corrected final density/score/Armijo/equilibrium reconstructions pass.
